name: minimax/h3-max-turbo/video-extend
display_name: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo Video Extend
description: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo, the fastest tier of the H3 family, continues an existing video with 1-15 seconds of new footage with native audio.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the continuation. Random when omitted.

video.title: Video Url
video.description: URL of the video to extend. Must be 1.625 s to 60 s long, up to 50 MB, aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5.

output.title: Output
output.description: 'extended' returns the whole source video followed by the new footage. 'continuation' returns only the generated continuation.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: The red panda keeps walking along the log, then looks up at a bird.
prompt.description: What happens next. Describe the continuation, not the source.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Seconds of new footage to add after the source. The actual duration may be slightly longer.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Matches the source video when omitted.

reference_audio_urls.title: Reference Audio URLs
reference_audio_urls.description: Optional audio references for the continuation (2–15 seconds each, 15 seconds combined). The full extended video retains its original source soundtrack, and its ending still conditions the transition. These clips guide the newly generated audio instead of using that soundtrack as an audio reference. Assign each clip a role in the prompt, such as 'Audio 1 for the voice' and 'Audio 2 for background music'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# MiniMax H3 Max Turbo Video Extend

MiniMax H3 Max Turbo video extend: continue an existing video with 1–15 seconds of new footage; return the joined clip or only the continuation.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 50,000 characters. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `4:3` / `1:1` / `3:4` / `9:16` | — | Output frame shape. |
| `video` | video URL, required | — | Clip to continue. |
| `resolution` | `480P` / `768P` / `1080P` / `2K` | `768P` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | integer 1–15 | 5 | Seconds of new footage. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `reference_audio_urls` | audio URL[] | — | Optional reference audio for the new footage. |
| `output` | `extended` / `continuation` | `extended` | `extended` returns source + new footage; `continuation` returns only the new part. |

## Billing

You pay for new seconds: $0.025 at 480P, $0.04 at 768P, $0.08 at 1080P, $0.16 at 2K.

| Output | 480P | 768P | 1080P | 2K |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5s (default) | $0.125 | $0.20 | $0.40 | $0.80 |
| 10s | $0.25 | $0.40 | $0.80 | $1.60 |
| 15s | $0.375 | $0.60 | $1.20 | $2.40 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe what happens next, not what is already in the clip.

## Also on SandBase

Other H3 Max Turbo endpoints: `minimax/h3-max-turbo/text-to-video`, `minimax/h3-max-turbo/image-to-video`, `minimax/h3-max/text-to-video` (H3 Max).
